title: Runescape: Dragonwilds - Scorned Wilderness Cataclysm Keep Guide
author: Jacob Fox
description:
Welcome to Cataclysm Keep, the fourth and final section of the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

Cataclysm Keep is the final leg of the journey to Kuldra's Sanctum, featuring parkour, Vault Sentinels, multiple Anima pylons, a riddle puzzle, and an elemental sequence that stands between you and the Dragon Gate.

You start out with a single mob followed by a large parkour section. After completing the first part of the parkour, you'll encounter several Vault Sentinels that need to be defeated.

After the Vault Sentinels, you'll reach three Anima pylons and four elemental trigger pads, with a riddle providing the clue for the correct activation order.

The Earth Anima pylon starts powered, while the Water Anima pylon is also already powered. The Water pylon area has two rotating switches. Flip both switches to activate a series of wall platforms, allowing you to climb up and reach the next room.

In the next room, you'll find the Air Anima. Flip the lever to open the gate and make future trips through the area easier. Charge yourself with Air Anima, bring it to the Orb dispenser to obtain an Anima Orb, and take the orb back to the Air Anima pylon.

Then return to the Air Anima source, charge yourself again, and use the Air Anima to power the pylon.

Next, follow the pipes toward the Fire Anima pylon. Stand on the Fire Anima pedestal to trigger three Vault Sentinels. Defeat them, charge yourself with Fire Anima, and use it to power the Fire Anima pylon.

Once all of that is done, parkour back across the pipes and activate the four elemental trigger pads in the correct order.

The correct sequence is:

Air → Water → Earth → Fire

Activating the triggers in the correct order opens the door leading to a staircase that takes you directly to the Dragon Gate and the entrance to Kuldra's Sanctum.

And that's it. You've made it through all four sections of the Scorned Wilderness.

The next challenge is the big one: Kuldra herself.

The Scorned Wilderness is made up of Level 8 areas, with Level 9 boss mobs sprinkled throughout. If you're preparing to explore the region, it's recommended that you first farm Rune and Luminite Ore to craft Rune gear. From there, you can farm Magic Trees and Vis to work toward higher-level armor and weapons.

That said, I went through the Scorned Wilderness wearing a full set of Obsidian armor and didn't have too many issues, so you don't necessarily need the highest-level gear to start exploring.

This is the fourth and final detailed guide covering each section of the Scorned Wilderness. I'll be combining all four sections into one complete Scorned Wilderness guide as well.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, gameplay, updates, and everything happening in Ashenfall!
